name: Terminal jumper bridge
summary: A terminal bridge intentionally connects specified terminal points to a common potential.
description: A terminal bridge intentionally connects specified terminal points to a common potential. The drawing needs the actual bridged positions rather than an undifferentiated line across an entire terminal strip.
readingNotes: Check skipped positions and separated terminal levels in the bridge plan.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A bridge is an intentional common connection; close physical spacing does not establish electrical continuity.
